blocks.text: MARAWI CITY — Around 1,000 student journalists and campus publication representatives gathered here on Tuesday for a forum on responsible journalism, democracy, and regional stability in Lanao del Sur. The Ranaw Campus Journalism, organized by the Provincial Information Office (PIO), carried the theme “Truth in Time of Transition: Campus Journalism as a Fortune for Peace, Democracy, and Regional Stability in Lanao del Sur.” It was held at the provincial gymnasium in the new capitol complex. In his welcome message, Vice Gov. Mohammad Khalid Adiong underscored campus journalists’ role in shaping public understanding through their stories, the issues they raise, and the […]...
